links.outcome: Accuracy of emergency detection in mental health support AI

links.quote: The emergency detection system also achieved 98% accuracy.

links.outcome: Differences in therapeutic effectiveness across languages and interaction modes
links.effect: ANOVA and Chi-Squared tests found no bias in effectiveness by language or interaction mode (p > 0.05).
links.quote: Statistical checks, including ANOVA and Chi-Squared tests, found no bias in effectiveness by language or interaction mode (p > 0.05).
